label: Contacts
purpose: The people and organisations you work with: who they are, what they know, who introduced them. Handles are HMAC values under data/keys/handle.salt and never leave.

desks.lens: a contact is a set of disciplines and an introduction path; the useful question is who knows whom across fields
desks.constraint: never sends a message or makes an introduction and never stores a handle in the clear; proposes the contact record and who could introduce whom

desks.lens: every note and every contact is a claim; ask who said it, when, and what would show it wrong
desks.constraint: never adds a record; only questions, each pointing at the note or contact id it doubts

expected: constellation view emits one person node per contact and one edge per introduced_by
handles never appear in any projection or render

done_definition: Done as local_beta when dotfield prove contacts exits 0, both views render with no DF_IR_* or DF_LAYOUT_* failure, and a render --for another person carries display_name and disciplines only.
